trusted_audit_authority_fields.required_traces: Exact expected service trace paths independently supplied by coordinator, never derived from offered evidence
trusted_audit_authority_fields.findings: Complete current finding inventory with id, feature, severity, disposition and resolution_artifact; critical/high requires resolution proof
trusted_audit_authority_fields.blockers: Complete current mandatory blocker inventory with feature, owner, dependency, evidence, remediation and review_date; any entry blocks acceptance
trusted_audit_authority_fields.redactions: Exact mapping of private original immutable artifact descriptor to published redacted path and preserved identity digest
trusted_audit_authority_fields.private_artifact_root: Restricted original evidence store; original credential-bearing bytes are never copied to outputs

signature: Same admitted independent reviewer signs exact feature, evidence and review hashes, complete candidate bindings, environment, current run/harness and digest of every trusted audit inventory
redaction: Deterministic bounded JSON/HAR credential redaction; retain transaction/block/chain/state identities; reject unstructured credentials, missing authority, changed identity or changed output
qualification_boundary: Adversarial evidence policy and independent attestation only; actual feature/device/provider/capacity/recovery and final release gates remain separate
